feeds.title: Life and Times of a Philippine Gamer
feeds.description: Life and Times of a Philippine Gamer is all about the experiences, thoughts, opinions, and rants of a die-hard RPG enthusiast born and bred in the Pearl of the Orient. A self-taught GM that has been rolling oddly shaped polyhedrons since the tender age of nine, Pointyman2000 brings his musings on bringing more fun to the table as both a player and a GM.

feeds.title: Inquirer.net » Esports
feeds.description: Get the latest esports news and pro-gaming tournament coverage for LoL, Dota 2 and Hearthstone.

feeds.title: Too Much Gaming
feeds.description: Too Much Gaming is a video game website based in the Philippines that tackles the latest gaming trends in the industry for console and PC platforms. Expect reviews, impressions, and detailed guides for the biggest games and the brightest gems. Get video game news, editorials, game updates, videos, podcasts, and gaming tips from Too Much Gaming.

feeds.title: Pinoy Gaming Network
feeds.description: Pinoy Gaming Network is a website designed to inform the Philippine's gaming population about the latest gaming trends. It also provides a window into the industry for enthusiasts of not only games but hardware and technology. It is the brainchild of Salleh and later Sir David.

feeds.title: Davao Geek Hub » Gaming
feeds.description: We provide tech news, gadget reviews, as well as helpful tips and tutorials. Davao Geek Hub is a Davao Tech and Lifestyle blog that creates content on the latest trends in technology, gaming, as well as geek lifestyle. The blog site is owned and maintained by Josef Cagas, a tech blogger and content creator.

feeds.title: Back 2 Gaming
feeds.description: With over 10 years of publication history, Back2Gaming is all about the technology powering PC gaming. Providing tech news and reviews for the PC and gaming enthusiast community, it is often cited as the best gaming and tech blog in the Philippines and we humbly accept the responsibility of maintaining the high standard that made Back2Gaming the best.

feeds.title: Kabalyero
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Kabalyero (it's my gamer name) and this blog is all about my adventures and experiences in the different games that I play I've been playing games for a very long time now. I also enjoy trying out different games and you'll also see my blog about them as well.

feeds.title: The Lifestyle Avenue
feeds.description: The Lifestyle Avenue offers a diverse exploration of topics ranging from travel to entertainment, food, and family life. With an approachable and warm tone, the blog shares personal experiences, recommendations, and reviews that cover all aspects of modern living. Whether it's tips for the best family getaways or insights into pop culture, the posts resonate with those seeking a balanced, joyful lifestyle.

feeds.title: YugaGaming
feeds.description: Yugatech.com is the largest and longest-running technology site in the Philippines. The site was first established in October 2002 and later transformed into a full-fledged technology site in 2005. Yugatech primarily covers consumer electronics, technology news, social media, automotive technology policy and provides in-depth reviews of the most popular devices released in the market, with a special focus on the Philippine landscape.
